episodes.synopsis: Banri Tada, a freshman law student at a Tokyo university ended up arriving late for his entrance ceremony.
episodes.title: Springtime

episodes.synopsis: Banri has a dream of himself, apparently injured, fleeing from a hospital, but upon awakening cannot remember any more than that.
episodes.title: Lonely Girl

episodes.synopsis: On the day of the scheduled club trip, Banri meets with Kouko and Nijigen, who is also invited.
episodes.title: Night Escape

episodes.synopsis: After Linda finds them, she explains that she was out on a club retreat with the Festival Club, and brings Banri and Kouko to their campsite.
episodes.title: Blackout

episodes.synopsis: After finding the photo of him and Linda, Banri runs to the bridge where the accident that caused his amnesia occurred to remember more, but cannot.
episodes.title: Body and Soul

episodes.synopsis: In a dream, Banri remembers that after his love confession to Linda, she agreed to tell him her response the following night on the bridge where Banri would have his accident.
episodes.title: Yes No

episodes.synopsis: Kouko tells Banri that she loves him, but before he can respond Kouko is arrested for stealing a bike that she used to catch up to Banri.
episodes.title: Masquerade

episodes.synopsis: In a flashback, Banri overhears Linda saying she does not see him as a lover, causing him to ignore her for days.
episodes.title: Reset

episodes.synopsis: Kouko suddenly falls ill and does not come to school for several days.
episodes.title: With You Again

episodes.synopsis: Ghost Banri, having awakened back in his physical body, feels the urge to see Linda.
episodes.title: In the Mirror

episodes.synopsis: Banri and Kouko ride the train and discuss Kouko's new Festival Club nickname "RoboGirl," so named because she looks like a robot when she dances.
episodes.title: Trouble Party

episodes.synopsis: Banri Tada is enjoying working as a waiter at the party, along with Nana, Mitsuo and Linda. Meanwhile, Kouko has texted Banri numerous times and is becoming concerned that he hasn't answered.
episodes.title: Don't Look Back

episodes.synopsis: As Ghost Banri watches, Banri dreams about when he was in the hospital and met with Linda, and about the message he was supposed to "pass along to her friend."
episodes.title: Summer Has Come

episodes.synopsis: 2D calls Banri and tells him that he heard Banri was lonely.
episodes.title: Ladies Talk

episodes.synopsis: On the day of the trip to the beach, the group encounters several mishaps on the journey.
episodes.title: Accident Beach

episodes.synopsis: The accident gives Chinami a bloody lip, dents the car's bumper, and damages the guard rail.
episodes.title: Wake-Up Call

episodes.synopsis: Banri arrives at the Golden Time restaurant where the Festival Club is setting up for a gathering at the Fireworks Extravaganza and the club members are strangely welcoming and eerily nice, which sets Banri on edge.
episodes.title: Return to Yesterday

episodes.synopsis: Kouko enters Banri's apartment alone after going through his mail because she misses him so much.
episodes.title: My Hometown

episodes.synopsis: Banri discusses the event of ghost Banri falling from the bridge with a doctor, who can do nothing more than provide a sedative for him.
episodes.title: Night in Paris

episodes.synopsis: After Chinami admonishes Banri for being too friendly with Linda because she's the girl Mitsuo likes, Banri catches up with Kouko to share everything that happened.
episodes.title: His Chasm

episodes.synopsis: After the incident at the Awa dance festival, Banri fears losing himself as his memories from before his accident return.
episodes.title: I'll Be Back

episodes.synopsis: Stunned by Kouko's words, Banri waits for her where she had rejected him, hoping she would come back.
episodes.title: Paradise Lost

episodes.synopsis: Banri confronts Kouko; she explains the reason why she decided to resign from the Festival Club is due to Banri's unwillingness to be in the same place as her.
episodes.title: Resignation

episodes.synopsis: Upon losing his recent memories, Banri returns to his hometown.
episodes.title: Golden Time
